name: Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
description: Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, over 2,200 m up. The thin air cuts downforce and cooling, the straight is very long, and the lap ends in the old baseball stadium.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (922 of 1720 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
